summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing the second tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme, announced on 6 May 2026. From 19-22 May, it repurchased 312,060 own shares at an average price of NOK 369.0578 per share, totaling NOK 115.2 million. The tranche runs through 20 July 2026. Post-transaction, Equinor holds 2.56% of its share capital as treasury shares (2.16% excluding savings programme shares). This open-market repurchase programme returns capital to shareholders, funded by free cash flow. Watch for continued buy-back execution and potential impact on EPS.
